title: Underived horizontal pasting of base change maps
statement:
Let A be an Abelian Grothendieck category with HasSmallSiteSheafify. For schemes X'', X', X, Y'', Y', Y and morphisms g'' : X'' ⟶ X', g' : X' ⟶ X, f'' : X'' ⟶ Y'', f' : X' ⟶ Y', f : X ⟶ Y, h : Y'' ⟶ Y', and g : Y' ⟶ Y, let sq₁ : CommSq g' f' f g, sq₂ : CommSq g'' f'' f' h, and sq : CommSq (g'' ≫ g') f'' f (h ≫ g). For every sheaf F on X, the component of the base change map of sq is the composite

(Etale.baseChangeMap A sq).app F = (Etale.upperStarComp A h g).hom.app (((f)_*[A]).obj F) ≫ ((h)^*[A]).map ((Etale.baseChangeMap A sq₁).app F) ≫ (Etale.baseChangeMap A sq₂).app (((g')^*[A]).obj F) ≫ ((f'')_*[A]).map ((Etale.upperStarComp A g'' g').inv.app F).

proof.text: Apply the existing proved lemma Etale.baseChangeMap_paste_horiz_app in WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.BaseChange.Pasting.
